scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent successfully diagnosed the assembly conflict despite some tool difficulties (file path issues, large outputs). It correctly identified the assembly, project, versions, and target framework. The main gap is not explicitly calling out MSB3277 as the error code. The approach was reasonable - it tried the dedicated conflict tool first, then fell back to error/warning searches and text search to find the relevant information.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict
